preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10,000.
The size of arrays A and B, N, must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**14 <= A[i] <= 10**14 for i in range(N)) and all(-10**14 <= B[i] <= 10**14 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: All elements in arrays A and B must be within the range of -10^14 to 10^14.
The sum of N over all test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if any(A[i] > B[i] for i in range(N)) else True
postconditions.description: If any element in A is greater than the corresponding element in B, output -1 indicating impossibility.
Output the minimum number of operations required to convert A into B.
